cynthia.name: Cynthia
dialog: Cynthia: The lake is closed to visitors just now. I wonder why?

rival.name: {rival}
dialog: {rival}: Which way did that Galactic creep go?

collector.name: Collector
dialog: Sorry, the road to Sunyshore City is shut.
They've had a blackout down there, and the crews are still working to get the lights back on.

beauty.name: Beauty
dialog: My suite key... it's gone! It must have slipped out of my pocket somewhere between here and the hotel.
A Pokétch that could sniff out lost things would come in very handy right now...
